title: Brand Page Content

fields.label: Brand logo
fields.name: kwv_brand_logo
fields.instructions: Optional. Shown above the introduction on the brand page. Use a transparent PNG, SVG or WebP. Leave empty to show no logo.

fields.label: Brand introduction
fields.name: kwv_brand_intro
fields.instructions: Optional. A short introduction shown under the banner on the brand page. Leave empty to show no introduction.

fields.label: Awards & accolades
fields.name: kwv_brand_awards
fields.instructions: Optional. Up to 8 award or medal images, shown in a row under the introduction in the order set here. Add a short description of each award as the image's Alt Text in the media library. Leave empty to show no awards.

fields.label: Brand website link
fields.name: kwv_brand_website
fields.instructions: Optional. The full address of the brand's own website, e.g. https://www.example.com. Shown as a "Visit brand website" link that opens in a new tab.

fields.label: Facebook link
fields.name: kwv_brand_facebook
fields.instructions: Optional. The full address of the brand's Facebook page. Leave empty to hide the Facebook icon.

fields.label: Instagram link
fields.name: kwv_brand_instagram
fields.instructions: Optional. The full address of the brand's Instagram page. Leave empty to hide the Instagram icon.

fields.label: X link
fields.name: kwv_brand_x
fields.instructions: Optional. The full address of the brand's X page. Leave empty to hide the X icon.

fields.label: YouTube link
fields.name: kwv_brand_youtube
fields.instructions: Optional. The full address of the brand's YouTube page. Leave empty to hide the YouTube icon.

fields.label: TikTok link
fields.name: kwv_brand_tiktok
fields.instructions: Optional. The full address of the brand's TikTok page. Leave empty to hide the TikTok icon.

fields.label: LinkedIn link
fields.name: kwv_brand_linkedin
fields.instructions: Optional. The full address of the brand's LinkedIn page. Leave empty to hide the LinkedIn icon.

description: Content for the brand pages (/brand/…): logo, introduction, awards, website and social links. Managed as code in the KWV Enhancements plugin's /acf-json directory.
